notes.title: Patch #16
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

I overhauled the whole balancing of the game. Some people found it hard to make enough money at the beginning of a mission to keep on playing, this is now drastically improved.

Small cities do now buy more products relative to bigger cities (e.g. sales figures do not anymore raise linearly with the size of the city). Also, natural resources now have higher margins and maintenance costs are slightly lowered.

Have fun!

notes.title: Out of early access
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

I am happy to announce that Oligopoly is now out of early access. Big thanks to the community for all of their valuable feedback.

[h1] Additions [/h1] 
[list]
[*]added the ability to disable edge scrolling in the settings
[/list] 

[h1] Improvements [/h1] 
[list]
[*]rearranged the missions of the first campaign
[/list]

notes.title: HUGE EA patch #15: translations (French, Italian, Spanish) + weather system + many improvements and fixes
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

I am happy to announce that Oligopoly has been translated into French, Spanish and Italian. This patch also brings many improvements and a new beautiful looking weather system, have a look here:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33122749/f8efa1e691f1cd617b318fd90d2ef0c744d20d58.png[/img]

Street lamps and vehicles are now emitting light:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33122749/3e6ec492261ce0fc6f563256f2936083b8265e14.png[/img]

Many things have been overhauled, like transportation routes visualization for example:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33122749/fdea0c04b56a1397276129b54397b5c5f9434ed5.png[/img]

Moreover, this patch brings approximately 20 improvements and bug fixes, see the following list for details:

[h1] Additions [/h1] 
[list]
[*]added translations: French, Italian, Spanish
[*]added weather system where it sometimes starts to rain
[*]added weather system settings, available options are: mixed, always sunny, always rainy
[*]charts fully implemented (chart datas are now saved and loaded as well)
[*]added transportation costs (your transportation routes now cost money)
[*]added transportation costs to the charts
[*]added pavement to standard road 
[/list] 


[h1] Improvements [/h1] 
[list]
[*]changed road construction animation
[*]prevent building windows from being partially out of screen when opening them
[*]store window slightly overhauled
[*]natural resources availability tooltip window redesigned
[*]natural resources availability is now always 100% or 0% (and no values in between) to keep things simple
[*]added emission to the tutorial arrow 
[*]improved transportation route visualization
[*]natural resources availability visualization remade from scratch
[*]standard road texture replaced
[*]electronics shop resized
[*]some tutorial texts improved
[*]various adjustments for different graphics settings (higher performance for low settings and higher quality for high settings)
[*]unity engine upgraded to the latest version
[/list] 


[h1] Bug fixes [/h1] 
[list]
[*]fixed a bug where stores had to be clicked twice to open it's window
[*]fixed a bug where the connected buildings visualization stayed active after constructing a building even if the mouse is not hovering it anymore
[*]fixed text overflow in store windows
[*]fixed a bug where after loading a save file the UI showed wrong balance for the first couple of days
[*]fixed a bug where vehicles did accelerate/decelerate too quickly
[*]fixed distorted road lines at intersections
[/list] 

Enjoy!

notes.title: EA PERFORMANCE patch #14 release
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

I am happy to announce another huge performance boost. The calculation time when a new road is built is about 10 times faster! Also, before, when playing for more than an hour, the FPS started to drop. This is now fixed as well.

This fixes lead to a very noticeable, much smoother overall gaming experience. Enjoy!

notes.title: EA PERFORMANCE patch #13 release
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

I am happy to announce a huge performance update. This patch brings a noticeable overall boost in performance and especially at later stages of the game, when cities become much larger.

I also tweaked various other things. For example the camera is much smoother when it tracks a vehicle. Also, I switched from forward to deferred rendering, which improves some graphics like trees for example.

Enjoy!

notes.title: BIG EA patch #12 release
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

I am happy to announce the biggest update since EA launch. This patch brings a new category of buildings, a new map, a new campaign and new missions.

As requested by the community, the new map contains much more landmass than the previous maps. So you have plenty of space to build. Have a look here:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33122749/60749430d744beca84f1772d6185528641472fd5.png[/img]

The patch also brings a new category of unique, expensive buildings, such as a company headquarter and a marketing agency. This buildings can only be built once and bring bonuses. Have a look here:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33122749/1ba2385cddfca876a57499bedf9ad4629fdc6c12.png[/img]

[h1] Additions [/h1] 
 [list]
    [*]unique buildings
	  [list]
        [*]company headquarter (maintenance costs for all buildings -20%)
	    [*]marketing agency (sales figures for all goods +20%)
      [/list] 
	[*]new map named Thaler
	[*]new campaign
	[*]5 new missions
	 [list]
       [*]Future Technology
	   [*]Company Headquarter
	   [*]The Hotel Chain
	   [*]Marketing
	   [*]Sun-Dried
    [/list] 
[/list] 


[h1] Improvements [/h1] 
 [list]
    [*]slightly decreased cities grow speed
	[*]decreased maximum game speed for better performance
	[*]some missions rearranged
	[*]some sounds replaced
[/list] 


[h1] Bug fixes [/h1] 
 [list]
    [*]fixed balance chart not showing negative values
[/list] 

Have a nice weekend!

notes.title: EA patch #9 release
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

I've created a new patch which will be released in the next minutes. As requested by the community, this patch adds charts to the game. Please keep in mind that this feature is in an alpha state. It works, but the data will not be saved.

Also, I have overhauled the visualization of connected buildings. You can now simply hover your mouse over one of your buildings to see to which other buildings it's connected. You can also hover your mouse over a store to see which city buildings are supplied by the store.

[h1] Additions [/h1] 
 [list]
    [*]Charts (work still in progress)
	[*]hovering the mouse over a building shows connections
[/list] 


[h1] Improvements [/h1] 
 [list]
    [*]added some missing german translations
	[*]slightly adjusted the layout of some user interface elements
	[*]removed the main theme music (this track now only playes at the end of a mission)
[/list] 


[h1] Bug fixes [/h1] 
 [list]
    [*]fixed a rare bug where a save file didn't load correctly (thank you John for finding it)
[/list]

notes.title: EA patch #6 release
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

I've created a new patch which will be released in the next minutes. This patch changes a little bit the growth of the procedural cities. At the beginning, the cities look now much more like a small village. Also, there are a few new buildings like a church, police station, town hall, etc.

[/list]

    [*]fixed some typos
    [*]fixed the vehicle depot bases from sinking into the ground
[/list]

notes.title: EA patch #5 release
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

a big thanks to the community who is actively giving feedbacks and finding bugs. This patch adds the ability to delete your save files from within the game. I also changed the game from exclusive fullscreen to windowed fullscreen mode. This hopefully prevents the issue some users had when alt-tab out and in again into the game, whereby the game switched from fullscreen to window.

[h1] Additions [/h1] 
[list]
    [*]deleting save files from within the game
[/list] 

[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1] 
[list]
    [*]fixed UI scaling issues for low resolutions
    [*]fixed a bug where the continue button in the main menu loaded the wrong data
[/list] 

[h1] Improvements [/h1] 
[list]
    [*]selecting a vehicle still opens it's transportation route, but doesn't track the vehicle anymore. If you want make the camera following your vehicle, you can select it now with the right mouse button instead 
    [*]slightly decreased saturation and contrast
    [*]slightly decreased the size of the product icon above buildings
    [*]switched from exclusive fullscreen to windowed fullscreen mode
[/list]

 [list]

[/list]

notes.title: EA patch #3 release
notes.content:
Hello lovely Oligopolists,

I've created a new patch which will be released in the next minutes. Many people have complained about the camera control, so I have completely rewritten it. The camera now moves in a more traditional way like other similar games. Also, you can now move the mouse cursor to the border of the screen and move the camera that way. I hope everyone likes it the way it is now.


[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]camera control has been rewritten
    [*]some minor improvements to UI scaling
    [*]product info tooltip slightly overhauled
    [*]tutorial adapted to the new changes
    [*]changed the format of dollar and pound (e.g. $42 million, instead of 42 mio $)
[/list]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
    [*]mission end animation now uses a 80 degrees field of view
[/list]
